items.example: I go to the gym after work.
items.simple: A big room with machines. You go there to make your body strong.

items.example: I try to exercise three times a week.
items.exampleTr: Haftada üç kez egzersiz yapmaya çalışıyorum.
items.simple: You move your body to make it strong. You do it to be healthy.

items.example: I work out at home on Sundays.
items.simple: You do many moves to make your body strong.
items.note: 'Çözüm bulmak' anlamı da var: It worked out.

items.example: That was a really hard workout.
items.simple: A time when you move your body a lot to be strong.

items.example: He's very fit for his age.
items.simple: Your body is strong and you can run a lot.

items.example: I swim to keep fit.
items.simple: You do things so your body stays strong.

items.example: I'm trying to get fit before the summer.
items.simple: You are working to make your body strong.

items.example: I'm trying to eat more healthy food.
items.simple: Your body is good and not sick. You feel strong.

items.example: I have football training on Tuesdays.
items.simple: You do the same moves many times to get good at it.

items.example: Which team do you support?
items.simple: A group of people who play a game together.

items.example: Are you watching the match tonight?
items.simple: A game where two groups play against each other.

items.example: I hope our team wins.
items.simple: You are first. You get the prize.

items.example: We lost 2-1 yesterday.
items.simple: You are not first. The other one is first.

items.example: What's the score? Who's winning?
items.simple: You ask how many points each team has.

items.example: He's my favourite player.
items.simple: A person who plays a game.

items.example: Our coach is really strict.
items.simple: The person who shows you how to play and get better.

items.example: Always stretch before you run.
items.simple: You pull your body long. You do this to feel good.

items.example: We warm up for ten minutes first.
items.simple: You move a little before a game, so your body is ready.

items.example: My muscles hurt after the gym.
items.simple: The soft part under your skin that makes you move.

items.example: I sweat a lot when I run.
items.simple: Water comes out of your skin when you are hot.

items.example: I jog in the park every morning.
items.exampleTr: Her sabah parkta hafif tempoda koşarım.
items.simple: You run, but slow. Not fast.

items.en: How often + do you...? I go twice a week.
items.example: How often do you go to the gym?
items.simple: You ask how many times a person does something. Like two times in one week.
items.note: Cevap: once / twice / three times a week.

items.example: I'm so out of shape. I can't run for five minutes.
items.exampleTr: Formum çok kötü. Beş dakika bile koşamıyorum.
items.simple: Your body is not strong. You cannot run much.
